items: Ten of home's animals are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: fox, stoat, marten, hare, squirrel, dormouse, badger, mole, hedgehog and snail, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend
They walk on eight frames instead of two, and legends wear plate armour cut with glowing runes
Asleep they lie down; sleeping legends curl up on their sides, and the snail draws into its shell
